measure_en: How far the rule set at a later rebuilding favours those ahead, against how far the rule set at an earlier rebuilding did.

plain_en: Starting fewer than the rest, with a return below the cost while they are, those who shape the rule lose ground to the rest every round.
plain_zh: 改规则的人起初比其他人少，而且人少的时候回到他们手里的抵不上成本，那他们每一轮都比其他人更落下风，不管规则隔多久重定一次。

The start is locked under the reversed order (the witness built in threshold_from_below, line 501). threshold_present_below (line 588) keeps the shapers present: they are outgrown, their head count need not fall.
needs: Stretched as threshold_rises is: the conclusion is the strict loss at every round (the missing direction question); that the hold stays is threshold_from_below with threshold_rule_below (lo ≤ c; not in the entry's declarations). 'turned' is the right Lean predicate (Locked under the reversed order, relative to the shapers) and the wrong word: the hold is for the rest from the start and nothing has turned. For held and turned to be told apart, the cast's 'those ahead' must mean the kind the law follows (those who shape the rule, the kind pays speaks of); by the cast's own gloss ('whom the rule now favours') this is simply 'held'. pays is left out of given: the hypotheses fix only that the return is short of the cost where the shapers are fewer (ruleshaping-lo-short); above the count it may exceed it, and under lo < c < hi it does. See the third answer for pays proposed at threshold_rises.

measure_en: the cost, against what returns to rule-shapers alone plus what their group gains from them, weighted by how much they are grouped together
measure_zh: 成本，对上只回到改规则的人手里的那份，再加上本组因他们多得的那份（按他们扎堆的程度折算）
within: at one round
plain_en: Across equal groups taken together, rule-shapers do better than the rest exactly when the cost is below their own return plus their group's gain, weighted by their clustering.
plain_zh: 分成一样大的小组、合起来看：成本低于改规则的人自己拿回的，加上本组因他们多得的（按他们扎堆的程度折算），他们这一轮才比其他人更占便宜。

needs: Stretched: pays' test counts only what returns to the doers alone. Here what a group gains through its shapers counts too, by how much shapers are grouped together, so the whole can favour shaping while pays is 'less' by the test inside every group (Assorting.either_verdict: cost two, one back alone). The tie is on the 'does not' side here and on 'enough' in the list. Missing distinction: who gets what the practice gives (the doers alone / those grouped with them / everyone alike), and at which level the comparison is made (inside a group / over the whole). With groups alike in shapers the line is the one-round line again, strict (grouped_alike_iff). Nothing is said of how groups form or of later rounds.

measure_en: the cost, against what returns to rule-shapers alone plus what members gain from the rule-shapers in their group, by how concentrated these are
measure_zh: 成本，对上只回到改规则的人手里的那份，再加上各人从本组改规则的人那里多得的（看这些人集中在哪些组）
within: at one round
plain_en: In groups of any sizes too, rule-shapers do better than the rest overall exactly when the cost is below their own return plus the gain where they concentrate.
plain_zh: 各组大小不一也一样：成本低于改规则的人自己拿回的，加上他们集中的地方本组多得的，他们这一轮合起来才比其他人更占便宜。

needs: Stretched as grouped_rises_iff is: what members gain from the shapers in their group counts, not only what returns to the shapers alone, and the tie is on the 'does not' side. Here each member gains for each shaper in its group, so a larger group shares more, and with unequal sizes the result is not fixed by the overall spread and the spread among group averages (Sized.either_verdict): 'how concentrated' is member by member, a member's group's number of shapers against its group's part of them.

measure_en: what returns to rule-shapers alone covers the cost however they stand against the rest, and under the starting rule; it never drops as they gain
measure_zh: 不管改规则的人占多大上风，只回到他们手里的都抵得上成本，开头的规则也是；他们越占上风，这份回报不会变少
within: from the round after the first rebuilding of the rule; their standing falls at no round from the start
plain_en: If what returns to rule-shapers alone always covers the cost and never drops as they gain, the rule is held for them after its first rebuilding.
plain_zh: 只回到改规则的人手里的总抵得上成本，而且他们越占上风这份回报不会变少，那规则头一次重定之后就为他们定住了。

The lock is stated at the round after each rebuilding; a schedule that never rebuilds gives only the first half. The exit's dropped premise ruleshaping-covers is exactly this row's pays = enough. The first conjunct (their standing never falls) speaks of the missing direction question.

measure_en: a round after the others start counting what is used up, those ahead are still few enough that the rule favours the others or ties
measure_zh: 其他人开始把耗掉的算进去后的下一轮，领先的一方人还够少：规则偏向其他人，或者两边持平
within: from two rounds after the others start counting, for good; it takes the rule being judged again at the round they start counting and at the round after
plain_en: The rule turns for good exactly if, a round after the others start counting what is used up, those ahead are still too few to keep it.
plain_zh: 其他人开始把耗掉的算进去，一轮之后领先的一方人数还不够，规则才会转到另一边，从此定在那里。

The list's 'counts: yes' is a test of the judging at every amount past a bound (closedcapture-turns); it is not a hypothesis here, and in this model it fails wherever the judging with the loss counted already favours those ahead at their numbers (kept_once_favoured: the hold is then kept). measure_en: runs that replace every rule-bender, one at a time, weigh at least the others' part of a step, multiplied once per bender: never zero
measure_zh: 把改规则的人一个个全换掉的走法，分量至少是“一步里轮到其他人的那一份”按改规则的人数连乘，不会是零
within: within as many steps as there are rule-benders, and at every later step
plain_en: With members replaced one at a time by chance, every rule-bender can be lost from any mixed group, even where the rule favours them.
plain_zh: 成员凭运气一次换一个，不管规则偏向谁，改规则的人都可能一个不剩。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnReplacement.lean:211 theorem lost_ge (k : Nat) : ∀ i, i ≤ M → ((M + 1) * (a + c + p)) ^ i * whole M a p c hi ^ k ≤ valueBy M (whole M a p c hi) (up M a p hi lo) (down M a p c) (stay M hi lo) lost (k + i) i. Docstring: 'wherever the critical mass lies'. lost i = 1 exactly at i = 0 (Drift.lean:969).
needs: The statement takes no side of the tipping count and no lo ≤ hi, so 'held' and 'source' are not in given: it is a law about the group ending all of one kind, from any mixed count. That the hold above the count is thereby left is the atlas's reading of 'from every count'; the chance model has no rule in force apart from the rule judged at the present count, so Locked is not stated in this module and no answer of 'held' names 'no one of that kind left'. judges: others is from the definition of the weight up (each bender among the M + 1 judges hi, each other lo); the ledger lists no pool premise for this law and its proof uses only the others' weight. 'ways: one' does not say WHICH one: this is 'no bender left'; 'everyone a bender' is fixed_ge. A lower bound on weight: it shows it can happen and gives no rate; the bound is above zero because a > 0 in the model, which is not a hypothesis of this statement.

measure_en: the cost lies strictly between what the others with a say see coming back and what the rule-benders with a say see
measure_zh: 代价严格夹在中间：高于说得上话的其他人看到的回报，低于说得上话的改规则的人看到的回报
plain_en: How many bend the rule decides whether bending pays exactly when the cost lies strictly between what the two kinds with a say see coming back.
plain_zh: 代价正好夹在两类说得上话的人各自看到的回报之间，改规则划不划得来才要看有多少人在改。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnShaping.lean:310 theorem critical_mass_iff (step : lo ≤ hi) : ((∃ x, CarrierCounts.favours (drawn a p c hi lo pos x)) ∧ ∃ x, (drawn a p c hi lo pos x).carrier < (drawn a p c hi lo pos x).other) ↔ lo < c ∧ c < hi
unplaced_why: The conclusion is that 'pays' has no one answer for the setup: the judged rule favours the benders at some count and the others strictly at another, exactly where lo < c < hi. That is neither 'less' nor 'enough', and it is not a border between them (it does not say which holds at a given count; critical_iff does).
needs: A third answer on 'pays': 'it depends on how many are doing it' (a tipping count), holding exactly where the cost lies strictly between what the two kinds with a say see coming back; or 'pays' asked of the present numbers, with this law as the condition for its border lying in the numbers. With lo ≤ hi the three regimes are exhaustive: enough at every count (c ≤ lo), a tipping count (lo < c < hi), less at every count (lo < c and hi ≤ c).

measure_en: the rule-benders stand to the others at least as (cost minus what the others see coming back) to (what the benders see minus cost)
measure_zh: 改规则的人与其他人的人数比，不低于“代价减其他人看到的回报”比“改规则的人看到的回报减代价”
plain_en: Where the cost lies between what the others and the benders with a say see coming back, bending pays exactly when enough already bend: a tipping count.
plain_zh: 代价夹在说得上话的其他人和改规则的人各自看到的回报之间时，改规则的人够多，改规则才划得来：有一个临界人数。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnShaping.lean:227 theorem critical_iff (short : lo ≤ c) (covers : c ≤ hi) : CarrierCounts.favours (drawn a p c hi lo pos x) ↔ x.other * (c - lo) ≤ x.carrier * (hi - c). Its unhypothesised form is drawn_favours_iff (line 200): favours (drawn … x) ↔ x.carrier * c + x.other * c ≤ x.carrier * hi + x.other * lo.
needs: The statement names only which way the rule judged at count x leans. It is put on 'pays' because that lean is the cost against what comes back, counted over those with a say as the group counts them (drawn_favours_iff; with both kinds seeing alike it is RuleShaping.favours_iff again, alike_favours_iff). But 'pays' ranges over the setup in the list and here its answer depends on the present numbers, so the row answers it at a count. No 'also' on held: the conclusion names no rule in force and no run. That the same count divides the two holds is true only of a run that starts under the rule judged at its own numbers, by drawn_locks, drawn_from_below and drawn_locked_either (their own rows; the last is the border on 'held'); under another rule in force the numbers can cross the count (the entry's open item, RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed). At a tie both sides of the hold stay (CriticalMass.at_mass_stays). given: lo ≤ c ≤ hi gives lo ≤ hi, which is source: results through drawn_reads_iff; the regime lo ≤ c ≤ hi itself has no answer to be given as (see critical_mass_iff).

measure_en: the cost is at most what the others with a say see coming back, and at most what the rule-benders with a say see
measure_zh: 代价不高于说得上话的其他人看到的回报，也不高于说得上话的改规则的人看到的回报
plain_en: Bending the rule pays at every count exactly when both kinds with a say see at least its cost coming back.
plain_zh: 两类说得上话的人看到的回报都不低于代价，改规则才不论人多人少都划得来。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnShaping.lean:257 theorem favours_everywhere_iff : (∀ x, CarrierCounts.favours (drawn a p c hi lo pos x)) ↔ c ≤ lo ∧ c ≤ hi. Docstring: 'With no hypothesis on the readers'.
needs: Exact on the 'enough' side only. The far side of this iff is not the answer 'less': it is 'at some count it does not pay', which includes the regime where a tipping count decides (critical_mass_iff) and, without lo ≤ hi, the case hi < c ≤ lo that the entry lists as open. 'Less at every count' has its own iff (disfavours_strictly_everywhere_iff). Drawn as less | enough it must not be read as 'otherwise less'. The law takes the pool and no lo ≤ hi: the half of judges.others's test that says each kind judges for its own is not used, and source is not fixed.

measure_en: the cost is above what the others with a say see coming back, and at least what the rule-benders with a say see
measure_zh: 代价高于说得上话的其他人看到的回报，并且不低于说得上话的改规则的人看到的回报
plain_en: Bending the rule fails to pay at every count exactly when the others with a say see less than its cost and the benders no more.
plain_zh: 其他人看到的回报低于代价，改规则的人看到的也不超过代价，改规则才不论人多人少都划不来。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnShaping.lean:284 theorem disfavours_strictly_everywhere_iff : (∀ x, (drawn a p c hi lo pos x).carrier < (drawn a p c hi lo pos x).other) ↔ lo < c ∧ hi ≤ c. Docstring: 'At hi = c, lo < c, the shapers are favoured at no share, however many.'
needs: Exact on the 'less' side only: the far side is 'at some count it pays or ties', not 'enough at every count' (that is favours_everywhere_iff). The two iffs are not complements; between them lie the tipping-count regime and the open case hi < c ≤ lo. As there, the pool is taken and lo ≤ hi is not.

measure_en: losing every rule-bender weighs at most the others' number times, per count above the tipping count, the others' gain over the benders'
measure_zh: 改规则的人全被换掉的走法，分量不超过“其他人的人数”乘上一串比值：从临界人数往上直到起点，每个人数上其他人所得比改规则的人所得
within: over any number of steps
plain_en: Above the tipping count, runs in which chance removes every rule-bender have a capped weight, and the cap falls with distance where the rule strictly favours them.
plain_zh: 在临界人数之上，凭运气把改规则的人全换掉的走法，分量有上限；规则严格偏向他们的地方，离得越远上限越低。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnReplacement.lean:225 theorem lost_above (pos : 0 < a) (step : lo ≤ hi) {s n t : Nat} (top : s + n + t = M + 1) (mass : down M a p c s ≤ up M a p hi lo s) (k : Nat) : ups (up M a p hi lo) s n * valueBy M (whole M a p c hi) (up M a p hi lo) (down M a p c) (stay M hi lo) lost k (s + n) ≤ t * ((M + 1) * (a + c + p)) ^ n * whole M a p c hi ^ k
unplaced_why: An upper bound on the weight of a change another row shows (exit 2, lost_ge: every rule-bender lost). It is not a keeping: the statement names no answer that stays. Its predicate is `lost`; Locked is not stated in this module; under chance a mixed group does not last (fixation), so what the bound protects is which end is reached, not the hold. Drawn as 'held stays held' it would be counted among the laws by which a rule rebuilt from its results is held, which it does not show. It is not a change either: it says how seldom that change happens from above a count the judged rule favours, and no shape here is a cap on a move.
needs: Either a way to put a cap on another row's change (a weight on lost_ge's row, as the earlier decision advised), or a question for WHICH end a group replaced by chance arrives at (everyone a bender, or none), on which this caps arriving at 'none'. 'ways: one' does not tell the two ends apart. The hypothesis mass is 'the rule judged at count s favours the benders', which with lo ≤ hi holds at every count above s (up_mono); s is any such count, not only the tipping count; no question asks which way the judged rule leans at a count in a model with no rule in force. The cap is t (the number of others at the start) times one factor per count between s and the start; near the tipping count it can exceed the whole and then says nothing.

measure_en: everyone becoming a rule-bender weighs at most the start count times, per count up to the tipping count, the benders' gain over the others'
measure_zh: 人人都变成改规则的人的走法，分量不超过“起点人数”乘上一串比值：从起点直到临界人数，每个人数上改规则的人所得比其他人所得
within: over any number of steps
plain_en: Below the tipping count, runs where chance makes everyone a rule-bender have a capped weight, and the cap falls with distance where the rule strictly favours the others.
plain_zh: 在临界人数之下，凭运气变成人人都改规则的走法，分量有上限；规则严格偏向其他人的地方，离得越远上限越低。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnReplacement.lean:239 theorem fixed_below (pos : 0 < a) (step : lo ≤ hi) {j n : Nat} (within : j + n ≤ M) (mass : up M a p hi lo (j + n) ≤ down M a p c (j + n)) (k : Nat) : ((M + 1) * (a + c + p)) ^ n * valueBy M (whole M a p c hi) (up M a p hi lo) (down M a p c) (stay M hi lo) (fixed M) k (j + 1) ≤ (j + 1) * ups (up M a p hi lo) j n * whole M a p c hi ^ k
unplaced_why: The mirror of lost_above: an upper bound on the weight of a change another row shows (fixed_ge: everyone becomes a rule-bender), from below a count at which the judged rule favours the others. The statement names no answer that stays; its predicate is `fixed M`; Locked is not stated in this module, and nothing has turned. It is a cap on a move, for which no shape exists here.
needs: As for lost_above: a way to put a cap on another row's change (a weight on fixed_ge's row), or a question for which end a group replaced by chance arrives at, on which this caps arriving at 'everyone a bender' from below. The hypothesis mass is 'the rule judged at count j + n favours the others', and so at every count below it (up_mono, lo ≤ hi). The cap is the start count times one factor per count from the start up to j + n, and can exceed the whole near the tipping count.

plain_en: It names the two numbers a lone newcomer's chances turn on: the benders' gains at every mixed count multiplied, and the others' gain multiplied as often.
plain_zh: 它给出两个数：各个混合人数上改规则的人所得连乘，和其他人所得同样次数的连乘；单个新来者凭运气能不能带走全体，就看这两个数。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/DrawnReplacement.lean:252 theorem one_each : riseBy M (up M a p hi lo) (down M a p c) 0 = ups (up M a p hi lo) 0 M ∧ riseBy M (up M a p hi lo) (down M a p c) M = ((M + 1) * (a + c + p)) ^ M
unplaced_why: An identity for two quantities of the chance model (the first and last steps of its potential), not a keeping, a change or a border. That a lone newcomer's chances turn on these two numbers is this identity read with fixation's limit (which needs lo ≤ hi): an argument in the module's docstring, not a Lean statement; the built examples give the two numbers' order in particular cases (Strong.other_first, Weak.shapers_first). What the entry lists as not shown is that the equal-numbers border (risk_dominant_iff) decides which newcomer more often takes over. 'exact' here means an equation, not an iff.
needs: A question for WHICH end a group replaced by chance arrives at (everyone a bender, or none): 'ways: one' does not tell the two apart. With it, this identity would give the measure of that question's border for a single newcomer. judges: others is from the definition of the weight up, not a hypothesis.

measure_en: at equal numbers: twice the cost against what the two kinds with a say see coming back, added together
measure_zh: 人数对半时：两倍的代价，对比两类说得上话的人看到的回报之和
plain_en: At equal numbers, bending the rule pays strictly exactly when twice its cost is below what the two kinds with a say see coming back together.
plain_zh: 人数对半时，两倍的代价低于两类说得上话的人看到的回报之和，改规则才严格划得来。

plain_zh: 只要起点上生效的就是按当时人数评出的规则，从第一轮起就定住了：不是定在改规则的人这边，就是定在其他人那边。

needs: A border, not an arrival: a start under the rule its own numbers give is held one way or the other at round 0 by definition (Locked there is `favours`, or `disfavours`, and a reflexive comparison) and stays so (drawn_locks, drawn_from_below, whose rows carry each side). Which side is which way the judged rule leans at the start; where the cost lies between what the two kinds see, that is the tipping count of critical_iff. 'Every start' is every count of members, not every configuration: a start under another rule in force is outside this law (the entry's open item; RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed), and the list has no question for whether the rule in force is the one the present numbers give; 'open' is exactly where such a start cannot be. The statement is a disjunction, not an iff, hence 'sufficient'. 'turned' here is the hold for the others from the start, not a hold that turned.

The law itself takes no closedness and holds on any run; the leaving side entails that the step's hearing is not closed for the group (members agree, so a speaker whose way differs is not a member), which agreement_kept takes as given. I wrote by = outside for that reason; with the missing question it would be by = itself given 'open', and never applicable given 'everyone'. Side condition in the statement: the group has a member other than the step's hearer.

measure_en: whether anyone, in the group or outside it, holds a different way for the thing
measure_zh: 群里群外，有没有人对这件事持有别的用法
within: at every later step, however what is heard is taken up
plain_en: If no one anywhere holds a different way for a thing, however they copy one another none comes back: everyone keeps the same way from then on.
plain_zh: 只要哪儿都没有人对这件事持有别的用法，不管怎么互相照搬，别的用法都回不来：以后每一步大家还是同一个。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:1078-1080 `theorem outside_needed {adopt : (M → F) → (M → F) → M → Bool} (r : Run (process adopt)) {n : Nat} {G : I → Bool} {c : M → F} {m : M} (imposed : ∀ i, G i = true → r.state n i m = c m) (kept : ∀ j, G j = false → r.state n j m = c m) (k : Nat) (i : I) : r.state (n + k) i m = c m`
needs: The statement is a keeping; 'necessary' is the atlas's word for the leaving it rules out (a different way must be held somewhere). As a keeping it is a sufficient condition for staying. The exit sentence's 'or a coined form' is not in this statement: it covers runs of hearing only (see coined_returns).

measure_en: a member holding the shared way hears, for one of two things it names alike, a different way kept by someone else
measure_zh: 用着共同说法的人，有没有就那两样同名的东西里的一样，听到别人留着的另一个叫法
within: at the next step
plain_en: Where the shared way names two things alike, a member who hears and takes another name for one, kept by someone else, tells them apart again.
plain_zh: 共同的说法把两样东西叫成了一样；谁听到并改用了别人还留着的、其中一样的另一个叫法，谁就又分得清这两样。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:1088-1091 `theorem outside_returns (r : Run (process (I := I) (M := M) (F := F) always)) {n : Nat} {c : M → F} {h j : I} {m m' : M} (heard : r.act n = ⟨h, j, m⟩) (ne : m' ≠ m) (kept : r.state n j m ≠ c m) (imposed : r.state n h m' = c m') (merged : c m = c m') : r.state (n + 1) h m ≠ r.state (n + 1) h m'`
unplaced_why: The conclusion is about ONE member's two forms: after the step the hearer holds different forms at m and m'. That is a distinction between two things regained inside one way of naming; no question here asks what a way tells apart. 'ways' asks whether members hold the same form for one thing, and the statement fixes nothing about the other members' forms at m (only the hearer's form at m' and the speaker's at m), so it does not say the group stops agreeing; that is run_kept_iff.
needs: A question on what the shared way tells apart: does it give two things one name or two (merged / told apart; Becoming.SharedCodes.Loses, Becoming.SharedCodes.TellsApart; premises sharedcodes-merged, sharedcodes-two-senses). On it this row would be: moves merged -> told apart for the hearer, at the next step, by outside (a form kept by someone not holding the imposed one: sharedcodes-kept-outside, the negation of what outside_needed takes).

measure_en: whether the newly made name differs from the name the shared way gives the other thing, and everyone hears it and takes it
measure_zh: 新造的叫法是不是不同于共同说法给另一样东西的叫法，而且人人都听到并改用了它
within: once everyone has heard and taken the new name
plain_en: With everyone on one way, a new name made for one thing, unlike the other's name, heard and taken up by all, lets everyone tell the two apart.
plain_zh: 大家都用同一套说法时，有人给其中一样东西新造一个叫法，跟另一样的叫法不同，人人都听到并改用了，于是人人都分得清这两样。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:1368-1371 `theorem coined_returns {all : List I} (every : ∀ i, i ∈ all) {c : M → F} {m m' : M} (ne : m' ≠ m) (o : I) {x : F} (fresh : x ≠ c m') (X : I → M → F) (j : I) : runBy always (broadcast o m all) (coin o m x (impose c X)) j m ≠ runBy always (broadcast o m all) (coin o m x (impose c X)) j m'`
unplaced_why: The conclusion is that every member holds different forms at m and m' after the coining and the hearing by all: what the shared way tells apart, not whether members agree. That all still agree at m afterwards is another law (broadcast_reaches, SharedCodes.lean:443). The statement does not take the merge (c m = c m') as a hypothesis, only x ≠ c m' and m' ≠ m.
needs: The same missing question as outside_returns (merged / told apart). On it: moves to told apart for everyone, by outside: coining is a step that is not a hearing (hearing makes no form: run_held), and the entry's open list says it is not shown that a coined form is heard. This entry's exit drops nothing; the sibling dynamic merged-distinctions-stay-merged cites the same law dropping sharedcodes-imposed. given ways = one is read from the statement's start, `impose c X` (every member holds the code c), not from a 'takes' premise. The hearings are under the rule that always takes what is heard (sharedcodes-always).

within: in one step
plain_en: In a built example of two who differ, three things each bring agreement in one step: following one of them, preferring one way, one hearing the other.
plain_zh: 在一个造出来的两方例子里，双方起初各用各的；三种办法各自都能一步让他们一致：都跟其中一方，偏向某一个用法，或者一方听另一方。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:1489-1492 `theorem three_agree : (Law.run centre start).state 1 false () = (Law.run centre start).state 1 true () ∧ (Law.run preferred start).state 1 false () = (Law.run preferred start).state 1 true () ∧ (Law.run ordered start).state 1 false () = (Law.run ordered start).state 1 true ()`, with `def start : Bool → Unit → Bool := fun i _ => i` (line 1429)
needs: A witness on two members, one thing and two ways (Bool, Unit, Bool): it shows the change can happen and gives no condition, so measure is empty. The two premises it drops (the exchange favours no member; it favours no way) are those of never_agrees_of_both and have no question here. by = itself as for exit 1: in each built example the exchange between the two themselves does it.

measure_en: whether a member hearing the thing hears it from another member of the group
measure_zh: 群里的人听这件事，是不是只从群里的人那儿听
within: through each hearing in which a member hears it only from a member
plain_en: A group on one way stays on it through every hearing in which members hear the thing only from other members.
plain_zh: 一群人用着同一个用法，只要群里的人听这件事都是从群里的人那儿听来的，就一直还是同一个。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:296-297 `theorem agreement_kept {X : I → M → F} {m : M} {e : Hearing I M} (agree : AgreeAt G X m) (closed : Closed G m e) : AgreeAt G (hearBy adopt e X) m`, with `def Closed (G : I → Prop) (m : M) (e : Hearing I M) : Prop := G e.hearer → e.sense = m → G e.speaker` (line 279)
needs: The statement is for one hearing; the keeping lasts while hearings stay closed for the group (the run form, run_agreement_kept, is not among the entry's declarations). Its gate (sharedcodes-closed) is the setup question the list lacks (see run_kept_iff); it is carried in measure, not in given.

measure_en: whether everyone there is, with no one left outside, holds the same way for the thing
measure_zh: 是不是所有人、一个不落，对这件事都用同一个
within: from then on, however what is heard is taken up
plain_en: Once everyone, with no one left outside, holds the same way for a thing, hearing one another changes nothing about it from then on.
plain_zh: 一旦所有人、一个不落，对一件事都用同一个，以后再怎么互相听，这件事上谁也不会变。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:529-531 `theorem all_agree_rest (r : Run (process adopt)) {n : Nat} {m : M} (agree : ∀ i j, r.state n i m = r.state n j m) (k : Nat) (i : I) : r.state (n + k) i m = r.state n i m`
needs: Here 'the group' is every member there is. That is what makes this an end with no way out by hearing, and it is the answer ('everyone') of the setup question the list lacks.

measure_en: whether the way of exchanging favours any member or any way, from a start in which neither is favoured
measure_zh: 交换的办法有没有偏向哪个人或哪个用法；起初把人对换、把用法也对调，看上去是不是还一样
within: at every step
plain_en: If nothing in how they exchange favours any member or any way, members who start out evenly split never come to agree.
plain_zh: 交换的办法要是既不偏向哪个人、也不偏向哪个用法，那么起初对称地各用各的几方，永远也用不成同一个。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:921-923 `theorem never_agrees_of_both (exchanges : KeepsExchange T π) (renames : KeepsRenaming T τ) {X : I → M → F} (symmetric : Relabels π τ X X) {m : M} (moves : ∀ x, τ m x ≠ x) (n : Nat) (i : I) : (Law.run T X).state n i m ≠ (Law.run T X).state n (π i) m`
needs: Stated for any law T on the members' ways (Law.run T), not only hearing; the members kept apart are those the swap exchanges. Its four premises (sharedcodes-keepsexchange, sharedcodes-keepsrenaming, sharedcodes-relabels, sharedcodes-moves) match no answer: a setup question is lacking, 'does the way of exchanging favour any member or any way?' (no / a member / a way). They are carried in measure only.

within: in one step
plain_en: If one set of ways is put on everyone at once, everyone agrees on every thing at once, whatever each held before.
plain_zh: 要是把同一套用法一下子加到所有人身上，不管原先各用什么，大家在每件事上立刻都一样。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:1036-1037 `theorem impose_agrees (c : M → F) (X : I → M → F) (i j : I) (m : M) : impose c X i m = impose c X j m`, with `def impose (c : M → F) (_ : I → M → F) : I → M → F := fun _ => c` (line 1029)
needs: by = outside: imposing replaces every member's ways and is not a hearing; the law shows what follows if one set is imposed, and the entry's open list says it is not shown that one is. No gate in the model, so measure is empty. What imposing costs (each loses exactly the distinctions its way drew that the imposed one merges: impose_loses_iff) is on the missing question of what a shared way tells apart.

measure_en: whether everyone holds the same imposed set of ways, for every thing
measure_zh: 是不是人人在每件事上都用着加上来的同一套
within: at every later step, however what is heard is taken up
plain_en: Once everyone holds one imposed set of ways, hearing one another keeps it at every later step, with every distinction it merged still merged.
plain_zh: 大家都用上同一套加上来的用法之后，再怎么互相听，以后每一步还是这一套，它并掉的区分也一直并着。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean:1106-1112 `theorem run_from_imposition {adopt : (M → F) → (M → F) → M → Bool} (r : Run (process adopt)) {n : Nat} {c : M → F} (imposed : ∀ i m, r.state n i m = c m) (X : I → M → F) (k : Nat) : (∀ i j m, r.state (n + k) i m = r.state (n + k) j m) ∧ (∀ i j, (∀ m n', ReadsAs (r.state (n + k) i) (r.state (n + k) j m) n' ↔ n' = m) ↔ TellsApart c) ∧ (∀ i m m', Loses X (r.state (n + k)) i m m' ↔ X i m ≠ X i m' ∧ c m = c m') ∧ (∀ q, (∀ m, c m = X q m) → ∀ m m', ¬ Loses X (r.state (n + k)) q m m')`
needs: Only the first conjunct is on ways. The other three (each reads every other exactly where the imposed set tells things apart; each has lost exactly what its own way told apart and the imposed one merges; a member whose own ways were the ones imposed lost nothing) are on the missing question of what a shared way tells apart, so no 'also' could be written.

measure_en: which word the speaker has counted more; on a tie the first word is said
measure_zh: 说话的人哪个词记得多；一样多时，就说排在前面的那个
within: after one hearing
plain_en: In one built example, two people with no word yet both come to favour the same word after one hearing, because a tie goes to the first word.
plain_zh: 一个搭出来的例子：两个人原先都没有偏向的词；因为打平时总说排在前面的那个，听一次之后，两人都偏向了同一个词。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.518-519: `theorem sayFirst_shared (i : Bool) : UniqueGreatest ((Law.run (hear (fun i => !i) (addHeard sayFirst)) zero).state 1 i ()) false`. No hypotheses: two agents, two words, one meaning, step 1 only. Start l.506 `zero` (no counts), which is related to itself (l.509 zero_symmetric); what is uneven is the rule: l.526 `sayFirst_not_alike : ¬ CommutesWithRenaming (fun (_ : Unit) y => !y) (addHeard sayFirst)`.
needs: Stretches: 'one' is anchored to SharedCodes.AgreeAt; here it is the same word uniquely greatest for both agents. From is 'several' only as 'none yet'. Only step 1 is stated, not that the shared word stays. What the exit drops (a rule treating the words alike) is an answer of no question here, so given is empty and 'outside' names nothing that changed; a question on whether anything tells members or words apart would hold it (this witness: the rule prefers a word, the start is even).

measure_en: each adds the other's counts to its own; one starts with one count for a word, the other with none
measure_zh: 各自把对方的记数加到自己的上面；起先一个人给一个词记了一次，另一个人什么都没记
within: after one round
plain_en: In one built example, one person already leans to a word and the other to none; after one round of hearing each other both favour that word.
plain_zh: 一个搭出来的例子：一个人已经偏向某个词，另一个人还没有偏向；互相听一轮之后，两人都偏向那个词。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.538-539: `theorem asymmetric_shared (i : Bool) : UniqueGreatest ((Law.run (hear (fun i => !i) addSpeaker) lead).state 1 i ()) false`. No hypotheses: step 1 only. Start l.530 `lead` (agent false counts 1 for false, agent true nothing); l.533 `lead_not_symmetric : ¬ Renamed (fun i => !i) (fun (_ : Unit) y => !y) lead lead`. The rule here does keep the relation (l.329 addSpeaker_keeps): only the start is uneven.
needs: Stretches: from is 'several' only as 'not everyone has come to one' (one agent already holds the word, the other holds none; no second word is in use). 'one' is the same word uniquely greatest for both, not SharedCodes.AgreeAt. Only step 1 is stated. What the exit drops (a start related to itself) is an answer of no question here; a question on whether anything tells members or words apart would hold it (this witness: the start is uneven, the rule is even).

measure_en: whether the rule and the starting counts look the same once members are exchanged and every word is renamed to another
measure_zh: 把成员对调、每个词都换成另一个词之后，规则和起点的记数是不是看不出变化
within: at every round, from such a start
plain_en: If the rule and the start look the same when members are exchanged and every word is renamed, a member and its counterpart never favour the same word.
plain_zh: 把成员对调、再把每个词都换个名，规则和起点要是看不出变化，一个人和跟他对调的那个人就永远不会偏向同一个词。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.216-220: `theorem never_shared (irrefl : ∀ a : V, ¬ a < a) (trans : ∀ a b d : V, a < b → b < d → a < d) (keeps : Law.KeepsRelation T (Renamed π σ)) {X : I → M → F → V} (symmetric : Renamed π σ X X) {m : M} (onto : ∀ u, ∃ v, σ m v = u) (moves : ∀ y, σ m y ≠ y) (n : Nat) (i : I) {v v' : F} (g : UniqueGreatest ((Law.run T X).state n i m) v) (g' : UniqueGreatest ((Law.run T X).state n (π i) m) v') : v ≠ v'`.
needs: given is empty because no question here holds this law's hypotheses, not because it has none: the law keeps the exchange with the renaming (countedcodes-keepsrelation), the start is related to itself (countedcodes-renamed), the renaming at the meaning is onto and moves every word (countedcodes-onto, countedcodes-moves). The gate is therefore carried in the measure only; read without it, the row says 'several stays several' with no condition, which the statement does not say. Needs a question on whether anything in the rule or the start tells the members, or the words, apart, with this law given its answer 'nothing'. The keeping is for the pair the exchange relates (i and π i), at one meaning; 'one' here is the same word uniquely greatest for both, not SharedCodes.AgreeAt.

measure_en: whether the rule and the starting counts look the same once the two members trade places and every word is renamed to another
measure_zh: 两个人互换位置、每个词都换成另一个词之后，规则和起点的记数是不是看不出变化
within: at every round, from such a start
plain_en: Where two members trade places and every word is renamed, and the rule and the start look the same, the two never both favour one word.
plain_zh: 两个人互换位置、每个词都换个名，规则和起点要是看不出变化，这两个人就不会同时偏向同一个词。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.225-230: `theorem never_shared_of_involution (irrefl : ∀ a : V, ¬ a < a) (trans : ∀ a b d : V, a < b → b < d → a < d) (keeps : Law.KeepsRelation T (Renamed π σ)) {X : I → M → F → V} (symmetric : Renamed π σ X X) (involution : ∀ i, π (π i) = i) {m : M} (moves : ∀ y, σ m y ≠ y) (n : Nat) (i : I) {v : F} (g : UniqueGreatest ((Law.run T X).state n i m) v) (g' : UniqueGreatest ((Law.run T X).state n (π i) m) v) : False`.
needs: Same empty given as never_shared and for the same reason: countedcodes-keepsrelation, countedcodes-renamed and countedcodes-moves are answers of no question here, so the gate is carried in the measure only. It differs from never_shared only in what it takes: the exchange an involution (countedcodes-involution) in place of the renaming being onto (countedcodes-onto).

measure_en: whether exchanging members and renaming every word changes the rule or the start; whether a member and its counterpart hold the same counts
measure_zh: 对调成员、把每个词换名，规则和起点变不变；一个人和跟他对调的那个人，记数是不是完全一样
within: at any round where the two hold the same counts
plain_en: If rule and start look the same with members exchanged and every word renamed, then whenever a member and its counterpart hold identical counts, neither favours any word.
plain_zh: 对调成员、把每个词换名之后，规则和起点要是看不出变化，那么只要一个人和跟他对调的那个人记数完全一样，就谁也没有偏向的词。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.243-247: `theorem shared_no_unique_greatest (irrefl : ∀ a : V, ¬ a < a) (keeps : Law.KeepsRelation T (Renamed π σ)) {X : I → M → F → V} (symmetric : Renamed π σ X X) {m : M} (moves : ∀ y, σ m y ≠ y) (n : Nat) (i : I) (same : ∀ w, (Law.run T X).state n i m w = (Law.run T X).state n (π i) m w) (w : F) : ¬ UniqueGreatest ((Law.run T X).state n i m) w`.
needs: Two stretches. (1) Shape: the statement is about one round under a hypothesis on that round (`same`, countedcodes-same); it is a keeping only as 'the answer holds at each round where the counts are the same', and it does not say that sameness lasts (addSpeaker_tied says so for one fixed rule). (2) Answer: the law is about the 'none yet' half of 'several, or none yet': alike in what they hold, with no word favoured. Under 'ways' that falls together with 'each favours a different word'. The evenness hypotheses (countedcodes-keepsrelation, countedcodes-renamed, countedcodes-moves) are in no question, so given is empty and the gate is in the measure. The statement concludes for agent i; for π i it follows from the same counts.

measure_en: each adds the other's counts to its own; whether swapping the two and renaming every word leaves the starting counts the same
measure_zh: 各自把对方的记数加到自己的上面；对调两人、把每个词换名之后，起点的记数是不是看不出变化
within: from the first round on
plain_en: Two members who keep adding each other's counts, from a start unchanged by swapping them and renaming every word, hold identical counts and favour no word.
plain_zh: 两个人每轮都把对方的记数加到自己的上面，起点在对调两人、把每个词换名之后又看不出变化，那么从第一轮起两人的记数完全一样，哪个词也不占上风。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.351-356: `theorem addSpeaker_tied {π : I → I} {σ : M → F → F} (involution : ∀ i, π (π i) = i) {X : I → M → F → Nat} (symmetric : Renamed π σ X X) {m : M} (moves : ∀ y, σ m y ≠ y) (n : Nat) (i : I) : (∀ w, (Law.run (hear π addSpeaker) X).state (n + 1) i m w = (Law.run (hear π addSpeaker) X).state (n + 1) (π i) m w) ∧ ∀ w, ¬ UniqueGreatest ((Law.run (hear π addSpeaker) X).state (n + 1) i m) w`.
needs: The conclusion has two halves. The second (no uniquely greatest word at every step after the first) is this keeps on 'ways'. The first (the two hold the same counts at every step after the first: one model, arrived at in one step) has no answer in the list and must not be read as 'ways: one': 'one' means one word favoured by all, and this law shows one model with no word favoured. The rule is a fixed one, so the law takes no keeping hypothesis; it still takes an even start (countedcodes-renamed), the exchange an involution and the renaming moving every word (countedcodes-involution, countedcodes-moves), none of which a question holds, so the gate is in the measure. Natural counts.

measure_en: the group's counts after a round of hearing, against the same counts with members swapped and words renamed
measure_zh: 听过一轮之后大家的记数，和对调成员、把词换名之后的同一批记数相比
within: after each round
plain_en: Where swapping members and renaming words changes neither who hears whom nor the learning rule, a group and its swapped, renamed copy remain copies after each hearing round.
plain_zh: 要是对调成员、给词换名，既不改变谁听谁，也不改变学的规则，那么原来的一群人和对调换名后的一群人，每听过一轮，两边仍旧只差一次对调和换名。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CountedCodes.lean l.288-290: `theorem hear_keeps {π p : I → I} {σ : M → F → F} {rule : M → (F → V) → (F → V) → F → V} (commutes : ∀ i, p (π i) = π (p i)) (reads : ReadsCountByCount rule) (alike : CommutesWithRenaming σ rule) : Law.KeepsRelation (hear p rule) (Renamed π σ)`. Law.KeepsRelation is IdentificationRuns.lean l.310: `∀ x y, rel x y → rel (T x) (T y)`. Takes countedcodes-commutes, countedcodes-readscountbycount, countedcodes-commuteswithrenaming.
unplaced_why: The conclusion is that learning by hearing keeps a relation: a state and its copy with members exchanged and words renamed stay so related after a step. Taken with a state related to itself, an even state stays even at every step (Law.KeepsRelation.run, IdentificationRuns.lean l.313). plain_en: Like paired with like, givers become a smaller part of the next generation exactly when a round received brings less than a round withheld keeps.
plain_zh: 同类配同类时，得到一轮带来的少于扣下一轮留住的，有来有往的人在下一代里占的比例才会变小。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1400: `theorem assorted_lowers_iff {a β γ n : Nat} (pos : 0 < a) (npos : 0 < n) {x : CarrierCounts} (some : 0 < x.carrier) : (CarrierCounts.select x (shaped a (β * n) 0 (γ * n) pos)).carrier * x.other < x.carrier * (CarrierCounts.select x (shaped a (β * n) 0 (γ * n) pos)).other ↔ β < γ`. This is the answer list's own border: lowered strictly exactly where 'less' (strict), not lowered exactly where 'enough' (tie included). Hypotheses as for assorted_raises_iff.
needs: As for assorted_favours_iff: like-with-like is not a question here, so given is empty.

measure_en: per pair after the slip: rounds the forgiving pair still receives, against the same rounds the answering pair withholds
measure_zh: 失手之后按对来数：放过的一对还能得到的那几轮，对上回敬的一对扣下的那几轮
within: over the rounds after one slip, in one generation
plain_en: After one slip, a forgiving pair goes on receiving where an answering pair goes on withholding; counted pair by pair, that is a costly practice's return and cost.
plain_zh: 各失手一次之后，放过失手的一对接着互相给，回敬失手的一对接着轮流扣；按对来数，这正好是一件费力的事的回报和代价。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1626: `theorem window_echo_shaped (a β γ t m : Nat) (pos : 0 < a) : (a + β * received windowed windowed (errAt t) first (t + (m + 1)) + γ * withheld windowed windowed (errAt t) first (t + (m + 1))) + (the same for second) = (shaped ((a + a) + β * (t + t + (m + 1)) + γ * 1) (β * m) 0 (γ * m) _).carrier ∧ (the two members' sum for answering answering (errAt t)) = (shaped ((a + a) + β * (t + t + (m + 1)) + γ * 1) (β * m) 0 (γ * m) _).other`. An equation of counts for every a > 0, β, γ, t, m; the atlas's word for the compose entry is standing 'proved'. Takes ruleshaping-pos only.
needs: No from/to for an identity. The units are pairs, each counted with what its two members leave together, and the 'others' here are another kind of giver (pairs that answer a slip), not keepers: the cast's 'those ahead / the others' hides that. Like-with-like and 'a slip was made' are answered by no question here.

measure_en: what a round received brings, against what a round withheld keeps: more, they gain; less, they lose; equal, neither
measure_zh: 得到一轮带来的和扣下一轮留住的：多，就多起来；少，就少下去；一样，谁也不动
within: one generation on, with at least one round after the slip
plain_en: After one slip, forgiving pairs gain on answering pairs exactly when a round received brings more than a round withheld keeps, and lose exactly when less.
plain_zh: 各失手一次之后，得到一轮带来的多于扣下一轮留住的，放过失手的对子才会比回敬的对子多起来；少于，才会少下去。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1664: `theorem window_echo_select_iff {A β γ m : Nat} (pos : 0 < A) (mpos : 0 < m) {x : CarrierCounts} (some : 0 < x.carrier) : (x.carrier * (CarrierCounts.select x (shaped A (β * m) 0 (γ * m) pos)).other < (CarrierCounts.select x (shaped A (β * m) 0 (γ * m) pos)).carrier * x.other ↔ γ < β) ∧ ((CarrierCounts.select x (shaped A (β * m) 0 (γ * m) pos)).carrier * x.other < x.carrier * (CarrierCounts.select x (shaped A (β * m) 0 (γ * m) pos)).other ↔ β < γ)`. The statement is on the rule-shaping rule for any positive base A (a wrapper of assorted_raises_iff and assorted_lowers_iff); the pairs enter by window_echo_shaped. Hypotheses: positive base, at least one round after the slip (pairselection-steps-after-error-positive), the forgiving pairs present.
unplaced_why: Partly stretched. The second half (lowered exactly where less) is the answer list's border less|enough. The first half (raised exactly where more) is a border inside 'enough': at exactly even neither kind of pair gains.
needs: An answer 'exactly even' on pays, as for assorted_raises_iff. Like-with-like and the slip are not questions here.

measure_en: the givers' average number left against the keepers'; it turns on how many pairs are mixed and how many rounds are played
measure_zh: 有来有往的人平均留下的，和从不给的人平均留下的，哪个多；要看一给一不给的对子有多少、一共几轮
within: in one generation, with no slips
plain_en: In a group of giver pairs, keeper pairs and mixed pairs with no slips, givers gain exactly when they leave more on average than keepers do.
plain_zh: 有两人都有来有往的对子、两人都不给的对子，也有一给一不给的对子，没人失手：有来有往的人平均留下的比不给的人多，他们才会多起来。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1278: `theorem answering_rises_iff (a β γ x y z d : Nat) : discord (whole (cohort x y z)) (Place.offspring a β γ (1 + d)) (amountOf Place.kind) < concord (whole (cohort x y z)) (Place.offspring a β γ (1 + d)) (amountOf Place.kind) ↔ (x * 2 + y) * (y * (a + β + γ * (1 + d)) + z * ((a + γ * (1 + d)) + (a + γ * (1 + d)))) < (y + z * 2) * (x * ((a + β * (1 + d)) + (a + β * (1 + d))) + y * (a + γ * d))`. No hypotheses; docstring: 'Read through the mean law kind_rises_iff; the four-term law (pairs_rises_iff) is not evaluated here.' Takes no ledger premise.
unplaced_why: The conclusion is whether givers gain in a group where some givers are paired with keepers. That is not pays as anchored here: the statement compares the two kinds' average offspring, not what comes back to the doers alone against the cost; what a giver gives a keeper goes to the other side, which pays's test has no place for; no joint law puts the mixed group on the rule-shaping rule (both compose entries are like-with-like only); and the border is strict (rises against does not rise), so a tie falls on the side the answer list calls 'enough'.
needs: Nearest: pays. (1) A question for who is paired with whom (only one's own kind / the other kind too). Then pays's border at 'a round received against a round withheld' is given like-with-like, and this law is the same border moved by the mix (with no mixed pairs and both kinds present the inequality is γ < β, by its arithmetic). (2) Either a question for whether the doers gain ground in the group (fall / stay / rise), kept apart from the per-round comparison, or a proved join of the mixed group to RuleShaping.grouped_rises_iff; none is in the atlas.

measure_en: what a round received brings is at most what a round withheld keeps; then no pair leaves more than two keepers do
measure_zh: 得到一轮带来的不多于扣下一轮留住的；这样任何一对留下的都不超过两个从不给的人留下的
within: in any one generation, over any number of rounds
plain_en: Where a round received brings no more than a round withheld keeps, no kind gains on those who never give, whatever the pairing and the slips.
plain_zh: 得到一轮带来的不多于扣下一轮留住的，那么不管怎么配对、谁失手，哪一种做法都不会比从不给的人多起来。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1146: `theorem never_rises_in_pairs {β γ : Nat} (le : β ≤ γ) (a n : Nat) {gs : List (List Place)} (paired : ∀ g, g ∈ gs → ∃ s, g = [s, s.other]) (others : ∀ s, s ∈ whole gs → s.kind = false → s.law s.side = withholding) : ¬ discord (whole gs) (Place.offspring a β γ n) (amountOf Place.kind) < concord (whole gs) (Place.offspring a β γ n) (amountOf Place.kind)`. Takes pairselection-beta-le-gamma, pairselection-listed-in-pairs, pairselection-others-withhold; none is an answer's premise. The dynamic's first-listed law; no item cites it.
unplaced_why: The hypothesis is the pays comparison at 'at most' (β ≤ γ: 'less' or exactly even, and the answer list puts even with 'enough'), so it fixes no answer and cannot go in given. The conclusion is that the kind does not gain in the group, for any pairing with keepers: at a tie that lies in 'enough', below it in 'less', and under mixed pairing it is not the rule-shaping comparison at all.
needs: Nearest: pays. A question for whether the doers gain ground in the group (fall / stay / rise), apart from the per-round comparison, with 'exactly even' as its own answer; and a question for who is paired with whom. Then the row reads: given 'at most even' per round, 'does not rise', for every pairing. The law holds on pairs, not member by member: erring_answerer_exceeds (l.1572) is the built counterexample, answering_never_rises (l.1120) the member-by-member law for givers who make no slips of their own.

measure_en: in each pair the forgiver gives every round and receives every other round, so it leaves no more than its partner
measure_zh: 每一对里，肯放过的人每轮都给、隔一轮才得到一次，留下的不比搭档多
within: in any one generation, over any number of rounds, with no slips
plain_en: With no slips, forgivers each paired with one who gives only every other round never gain, whatever a round received brings or a round withheld keeps.
plain_zh: 没人失手，每个肯放过一次失手的人都配一个隔一轮才给一次的人，那么不管两种回报是多少，肯放过的人都不会多起来。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1741: `theorem window_never_rises_beside_alternators (a β γ n y : Nat) : ¬ discord (whole (List.replicate y [windowAlternator, windowAlternator.other])) (Place.offspring a β γ n) (amountOf Place.kind) < concord (whole (List.replicate y [windowAlternator, windowAlternator.other])) (Place.offspring a β γ n) (amountOf Place.kind)`. No hypotheses and no ledger premise: it holds for any β and γ, on a group built only of such mixed pairs. windowAlternator (l.1722) is built with noErrors, so it is shown without slips only (window_below_alternator, l.1728: the forgiver leaves (β + γ)·half (n + 1) less than its partner).
unplaced_why: The conclusion is that the doers do not gain, for any β and γ: it does not turn on the pays comparison. What decides it is that every forgiver is paired with the other kind, and no question records who is paired with whom.
needs: Nearest: pays. The question of who is paired with whom (here: only with the other kind) and an outcome question (do the doers gain ground) apart from the per-round comparison. With like paired with like the same two kinds are on the pays border (window_alternator_favours_iff, l.1798, cited by no item and left out by the rule).

measure_en: everyone gives and receives at every round, so everyone leaves the same number
measure_zh: 人人每轮都给、每轮都得到，留下的一样多
within: in any one generation, over any number of rounds
plain_en: Where everyone keeps giving after giving both ways and no one slips, everyone leaves the same, and nothing is picked, whatever the returns.
plain_zh: 人人都在互相给过之后接着给，又没人失手，那么不管两种回报是多少，大家留下的一样多，什么也挑不出来。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PairSelection.lean l.1429: `theorem neutral (a β γ n : Nat) {ps : List Place} (giving : ∀ s, s ∈ ps → s.law first (true, true) (true, true) = true ∧ s.law second (true, true) (true, true) = true ∧ s.errs = noErrors) (amount : Place → Nat) : concord ps (Place.offspring a β γ n) amount = 0 ∧ discord ps (Place.offspring a β γ n) amount = 0`. Takes pairselection-laws-give-after-mutual-giving and pairselection-no-errors; neither is an answer's premise.
unplaced_why: The conclusion is that nothing is picked for any trait, for any β and γ: everyone leaves a + β·n. That is 'exactly even', which the answer list has only inside 'enough', and the law does not turn on the comparison at all.
needs: An answer 'exactly even: nothing is picked', on pays or on an outcome question. The hypothesis (every way in use gives after mutual giving) is not ways: 'everyone the same one': the ways may differ and only behave alike while no one withholds.

measure_en: for n rounds more is taken from what they live on than comes back, starting from less than n plus the least any member needs
measure_zh: 连着 n 轮，从他们靠着活的东西里拿走的比补回来的多，而开头的存量不到 n 加上每个成员至少要用的量
within: at the generation after the n rounds, and after any later generation whose members all depend on it
plain_en: A line whose members all live on something that is taken faster than it comes back, from too small a stock, leaves no next generation.
plain_zh: 一代传一代的一支人，都靠同一样东西活，这样东西被拿走的比补回来的快、存量又不够，就传不到下一代。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GroupEnding.lean:238-247: `(excess : ∀ k, k < n → L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)) (start : W.stock ds T < n + m) (k : Nat) (coupled : ∀ p, p ∈ G.family (T + n + k) → ∃ e, e ∈ ds ∧ W.requires (T + n + k) p e ∧ m ≤ W.need (T + n + k) p e) (y : X) : ¬ y ∈ G.family (T + n + k + 1)`. It also takes balances, acting, dependent, descended and gated (whatever gives to the family depends on a member of it at a need of at least m). No rule, no one ahead and no one with a say appear in the statement; none of its ledger premises is an answer's premise.
needs: Placed on `on` for those who live on it (the line), not for what is used up. The overdraw is in measure only: no question asks it without a rule, and draws: down (a rule's uncounted loss growing, ClosedCapture.Accrues) is another model's quantity with no joint law onto Flow's stock, so it is not in given. by is 'itself' although the exit drops a premise: the premise dropped (the line persists) is the negation of this law's own conclusion, an answer on this same question, not a setting altered from outside; what gates the ending is the overdraw, a hypothesis on the same course. The exit's target, selection-among-groups-by-ending (family A), is outside the region.

plain_en: Read this way, the hold stays while what those ahead use up removes those who would notice: self-keeping and using-up as one course, nobody aiming at it.
plain_zh: 这样读：格局定着不动，领先的一方耗掉的东西又把会察觉的人带走了，自保和耗用是同一条路上的两半，谁也不用存心去做。

measure_en: for n rounds more was taken from what it lives on than came back, starting from less than n plus the least any member needs
measure_zh: 连着 n 轮，从它靠着活的东西里拿走的比补回来的多，而开头的存量不到 n 加上每个成员至少要用的量
within: at no time, for no length of stretch
plain_en: A line that goes on without end never had what it lives on taken faster than it came back long enough to run a small stock out.
plain_zh: 能一直传下去的一支，它靠着活的东西从来没有被连着拿得比补回来的快、快到把本来不多的存量耗到不够用。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PersistingChoices.lean:456-464: `(coupled : ∀ s p, p ∈ G.family s → ∃ e, e ∈ ds ∧ W.requires s p e ∧ m ≤ W.need s p e) (persists : G.Persists) (T n : Nat) : ¬ ((∀ k, k < n → L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)) ∧ W.stock ds T < n + m)`, with `Persists G := ∀ N, ∃ s y, N ≤ s ∧ y ∈ G.family s` (:423). Also takes balances, acting, dependent, descended, gated.
unplaced_why: The hypothesis is an answer (on: goes-on, and more: without end); the conclusion is about the past course, that no stretch of overdraw from a short stock ever happened. No question asks, without a rule, whether what a line lives on is taken faster than it comes back, and no shape says what holding an answer rules out. It is exit 1's law (coupled_generation_childless) read from the surviving side, its contrapositive with every generation depending on the family, so it is not a second step and must not be counted as one.
needs: Either a field on exit 1's row for its backward reading (what still going on shows), or a question about [those who live on it, live on, what is used up] with no rule in it: 'Is what they live on taken faster than it comes back?' (no, or never for n rounds from below n + m / yes). On that question this law is given {on: goes-on} with the answer 'no'. The nearest listed answer is draws: spare, but its test is about the outcomes a rule allows, and draws has 'those ahead' as the takers; here anyone may take and there is no rule.

measure_en: for n rounds more was taken from what it lives on than came back, starting from less than n plus the least any member needs
measure_zh: 连着 n 轮，从它靠着活的东西里拿走的比补回来的多，而开头的存量不到 n 加上每个成员至少要用的量
within: for every stretch that ended before that round; nothing about a stretch still open at it
plain_en: If a line still has a member at some round, no stretch ending before that round overdrew what it lives on from too small a stock.
plain_zh: 到某一轮这一支还有人在，那在这一轮之前结束的任何一段里，它靠着活的东西都没有在存量不够时被拿得比补回来的多。
evidence: experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PersistingChoices.lean:435-443: `{T n s : Nat} {y : X} (late : T + n < s) (member : y ∈ G.family s) : ¬ ((∀ k, k < n → L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)) ∧ W.stock ds T < n + m)`. Same other hypotheses as persists_never_overdraws, which is its case at a member past T + n.
unplaced_why: The finite, dated form of persists_never_overdraws: the hypothesis is an answer at one round (the line has a member then; given on: goes-on is at that round only), the conclusion rules out an overdraw in any stretch that closed before it. Exit 1's law read backwards; no question asks about the overdraw.
needs: As for persists_never_overdraws. This is the form a clocked reading would use: it dates what a member still there rules out, and is silent on a stretch not yet closed. It also shows that `on` needs to tell 'still going at a round' from 'goes on without end'.

within: on the cases met so far, where a keeping and an ending option were open together
plain_en: A line that never ends never chose what would end it; its choices fit a ranking of keeping above ending, which does not show it has one.

Nearest question now: reach (to 'someone'), a loose fit, since the someone has no say.
